query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "function-aware fill-in-the-middle as mid-training for coding agent fou" computer science
rationale: The paper directly extends the Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) objective — the same mechanism at the core of the user's follow-up on function-aware FIM mid-training — satisfying criterion (a) same-mechanism evidence (and (b), measuring FIM-based code completion on code corpora). It is canonical prior work on modifying the FIM objective for code models.
